title: Stagebench Nord Stage 4 four-phase evaluation rubric

anchors.0: Missing, broken, disconnected, or no credible exercised evidence.
anchors.1: Present only as a minimal, placeholder, display-only, or substantially incorrect implementation.
anchors.2: Partially complete with important fidelity, integration, or behavior gaps.
anchors.3: Strong and substantially complete against the assigned specs, with limited gaps.
anchors.4: Exceptional fidelity, integration, and completeness against the image, manual, and assigned specs.

1.name: Visual recreation
1.description: Scores reference fidelity, exact visible inventory, interaction state, and implementation quality.

criteria.label: Silhouette and proportions
criteria.guidance: Compare continuous chassis, deck/keybed ratio, end cheeks, keyboard, and overall bounds with the primary image and visual spec.

criteria.label: Panel layout and density
criteria.guidance: Compare section landmarks, widths, grouping, density, and placement. Invented primary hardware prevents a rating above 1.

criteria.label: Control materials and color
criteria.guidance: Assess reference-specific knobs, switches, drawbars, faders, LEDs, OLEDs, red metal, and slate panels.

criteria.label: Typography and displays
criteria.guidance: Assess legends, branding, hierarchy, exact display locations, and small-label legibility.

criteria.label: Visible hardware inventory
criteria.guidance: Check exact keyboard and required section-specific hardware. Penalize generic matrices and wrong-section controls.

criteria.label: Visual state coverage
criteria.guidance: Exercise illuminated, pressed, rotated, toggled, hover, and focus states through canonical hardware state.

criteria.label: Control interaction
criteria.guidance: Exercise keys, buttons, knobs, LEDs, and displays; reward coherent coupled feedback rather than decorative local state.

criteria.label: Responsive accessibility
criteria.guidance: Check clipping, focus, labels, keyboard control, narrow behavior, and practical interaction targets.

criteria.label: Component and data structure
criteria.guidance: Assess stable IDs, normalized section-specific data, understandable React/CSS, and reusable primitives.

criteria.label: Runtime quality
criteria.guidance: Assess tests, console cleanliness, stability, loading, and avoidable rendering/layout problems.

2.name: Piano instrument
2.description: Scores visual retention, Piano spec coverage, real audio behavior, playability, and architecture.

criteria.label: Reference fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Confirm Phase 1 geometry, inventory, materials, and display fidelity remain intact.

criteria.label: Responsive chassis
criteria.guidance: Check complete keyboard/chassis, scaling, clipping, and narrow behavior after audio/status integration.

criteria.label: Input coverage
criteria.guidance: Verify pointer, multitouch, computer keyboard, and MIDI all drive one note lifecycle including failure states.

criteria.label: Piano controls
criteria.guidance: Verify Piano spec controls update canonical state and audible behavior where claimed.

criteria.label: Display and status feedback
criteria.guidance: Verify selection, parameters, voices, MIDI/audio readiness, fallback, and errors are truthful.

criteria.label: Piano sound source
criteria.guidance: Require credible bundled recordings or comparably convincing modeling. Short additive buffers presented as samples rate at most 1.

criteria.label: Note lifecycle and cleanup
criteria.guidance: Exercise attack, release, repeated/overlapping notes, stuck-note prevention, Panic, voice limits, and node cleanup.

criteria.label: Velocity and sonic controls
criteria.guidance: Verify velocity and supported Piano controls measurably alter rendered audio.

criteria.label: Sustain and polyphony
criteria.guidance: Exercise sustain transitions, half-pedal approximation, useful polyphony, stealing, and cleanup.

criteria.label: Playability
criteria.guidance: Assess latency, reliable triggering, repeated play, key mapping, multi-touch, and sustained performance.

criteria.label: Control feedback
criteria.guidance: Check immediate visual and audible feedback for played notes and parameters.

criteria.label: Failure handling
criteria.guidance: Check denied MIDI, unavailable audio, asset failures, focus loss, cleanup, and truthful fallback status.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess UI/state/input/voice/audio separation and direct tests of the real backend.

criteria.label: Performance and cleanup
criteria.guidance: Assess reuse, cleanup, voice disposal, rapid-play stability, and console state.

3.name: Programs and effects
3.description: Scores canonical Program behavior, performance systems, connected effects, routing, and inherited fidelity.

criteria.label: Reference fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Compare the Phase 3 render with the primary image and inherited evidence.

criteria.label: Hardware state fidelity
criteria.guidance: Check Programs, layers, splits, morphs, scenes, focus, and effects are represented through credible hardware states.

criteria.label: Program and preset workflows
criteria.guidance: Exercise canonical round-trip, dirty state, store/store-as, lists, categories, undo/cancel, Live Mode, and rendered navigation.

criteria.label: Splits, scenes, and morphs
criteria.guidance: Exercise editable split points/crossfades/zones, two scenes, morph input paths/interpolation/indicators, and master performance state.

criteria.label: Display and editing behavior
criteria.guidance: Verify contextual displays, parameter editing, focus, list modes, copy/paste, and Program controls.

criteria.label: Shared audio graph
criteria.guidance: Verify one AudioContext, per-layer buses, ordered chains, master bus/limiter, and cleanup.

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
criteria.guidance: Exercise representative Mod 1/2, Delay, Amp/EQ/filter, Compressor, Reverb, and Rotary audio. Metadata-only units rate 0.

criteria.label: Effect routing and control
criteria.guidance: Verify focus, group/global, per-layer targeting, bypass, dry/wet, ordering, automation, Delay feedback path, and To Rotary.

criteria.label: Program behavior
criteria.guidance: Exercise Program state transitions as one coherent system rather than isolated models.

criteria.label: Routing and control mapping
criteria.guidance: Check visible Program/effect controls target canonical state and audible routing with correct focus.

criteria.label: Regression resistance
criteria.guidance: Confirm inherited visual interaction and Piano audio remain functional through Programs and effects.

criteria.label: System architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess canonical state, serialization, bus/effect composition, engine boundaries, and Phase 4 extensibility.

criteria.label: Test quality
criteria.guidance: Inspect direct real-boundary audio tests, inherited coverage, and meaningful behavioral assertions.

criteria.label: Reliability and performance
criteria.guidance: Assess console state, clicks/clipping, cleanup, rapid interaction, CPU behavior, and render stability.

4.name: Organ and synth
4.description: Scores distinct Organ/Synth engines, complete hardware behavior, full-system integration, and final reliability.

criteria.label: Reference fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Compare the final instrument with the primary image and inherited evidence.

criteria.label: Organ and Synth hardware state
criteria.guidance: Assess model/source, drawbar/register, filter/envelope, voice, arp, focus, morph, split, and effect indicators.

criteria.label: Organ engine
criteria.guidance: Exercise two layers, six distinct models, drawbars/registers, percussion, key click, vibrato/chorus, presets/live state, and rotary.

criteria.label: Synth engine
criteria.guidance: Exercise three layers, source families, Osc Ctrl, filters, envelopes, LFO, voice modes, vibrato, and arpeggiator/gate.

criteria.label: Full-system integration
criteria.guidance: Verify new engines work with inherited Programs, presets, scenes, zones, splits, morphs, focus, clock, and effects.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
criteria.guidance: Assess musical usefulness and exercised spectral/time-domain differences. Renaming one oscillator rates at most 1.

criteria.label: Inherited effect integration
criteria.guidance: Verify Organ/Synth layers use Phase 3 buses, effects, Rotary, targeting, and gain staging without separate destinations.

criteria.label: Quality, latency, and load
criteria.guidance: Exercise clicks, clipping, voice limits, latency, cleanup, layered stress, and CPU stability.

criteria.label: Hardware control mapping
criteria.guidance: Audit every required Phase 4 control for meaningful canonical and audible behavior; generic no-op fallback rates 0.

criteria.label: Program and display integration
criteria.guidance: Verify engine state round-trips through Programs/presets and drives contextual displays/editing.

criteria.label: State and routing
criteria.guidance: Exercise layers, zones, scenes, morphs, focus, clocks, engine/effect assignments, and transitions together.

criteria.label: Regression resistance
criteria.guidance: Confirm all inherited visual, Piano, Program, split, morph, scene, preset, and effect behavior remains functional.

criteria.label: System architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess engine boundaries, one-context graph, state ownership, routing abstractions, and extensibility.

criteria.label: Maintainability and tests
criteria.guidance: Assess naming, modularity, duplication, documentation, inherited tests, and real-boundary engine tests.

criteria.label: Reliability and performance
criteria.guidance: Assess console cleanliness, cleanup, render stability, audio performance, and rapid layered interaction.
